title: 🔺 US "Al Minhad" base in the UAE targeted by Iran's army drones
text:
🔺 US "Al Minhad" base in the UAE targeted by Iran's army drones"

" The Islamic Republic of Iran Army attacked the locations of US helicopters and forces at the "Al Minhad" base in the UAE with destruction drones."

"Army Public Relations: Iran"

"Since early this morning, in response to the recent aggressions of the aggressor enemy and in revenge for the brave martyrs of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and the innocent people of Islamic Iran on Larak Island, the Islamic Republic of Iran Army targeted the locations of helicopters and forces of the child-killing US army at the "Al Minhad" base in the UAE by firing dozens of destruction drones."

"Al Minhad base is one of the important support and air transportation hubs for foreign forces."

"The Army Public Relations, referring to the recent enemy aggression on Larak Island, announced that the warriors of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army stand for ensuring sustainable security and protecting the territory of Islamic Iran until the enemy's threat is removed from the region, and they will take revenge for the blood of all the martyrs of the Imposed War from the American terrorist forces.
